Messages.Author: technobabble66
Messages.Body:
Simple q's, but i can't find a clarification.

Can Shell Game select tapped vamps (tho i assume if it can, they wont
boost the stealth as they're already tapped); and if so, would they
untap at the end of a successful action?

I assume the vamps selected MUST be untapped to begin with, otherwise
this seems like an amazing untapping card to surpass Freak Drive.

Shell Game
Action Modifier
Sanguinus
Only usable when the action is announced.
san: Tap X other ready Blood Brothers you control of the same circle
as this one to give this Blood Brother +X stealth (even if stealth is
not yet needed). If the action is successful, you may untap one of
those Blood Brothers.
SAN: As above, but untap an additional one of those Blood Brothers if
the action is successful.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Feb 2, 8:32 am, technobabble66 <stujaq...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> Simple q's, but i can't find a clarification.
>
> Can Shell Game select tapped vamps (tho i assume if it can, they wont
> boost the stealth as they're already tapped); and if so, would they
> untap at the end of a successful action?

"tap ... to". Tap them to get some effect. If they're already tapped,
then you can't tap them to get that effect.

Similarly you cannot tap a tapped Barrens to discard a card.



Messages.Author: Powerlord
Messages.Body:
On 2 Fev, 13:32, technobabble66 <stujaq...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> Simple q's, but i can't find a clarification.
>
> Can Shell Game select tapped vamps (tho i assume if it can, they wont
> boost the stealth as they're already tapped); and if so, would they
> untap at the end of a successful action?

You only untap one at inferior SAN and two at superior SAN, regardless
the number of BB you tap, but you are forced to tap untapped ones.
